title: HelperSessionAttachParams
description: Params of the helper session service's attach op: make one subscriber a reader of one host session. A new attachment is a new READER of an existing stream and never a new stream, which is why the subscriber, the session and the offset are three separate fields and no two of them can stand in for each other.

offset.description: Where this subscriber resumes. A reconnect names the offset it last received; a reader with no position of its own names the base the inventory reported, exactly as a fresh renderer attaches at sessions.live's replayFrom today. It is never inferred from `fresh`, and `fresh` is never inferred from it.

fresh.description: The caller has no render state. It is a FLAG and never an inference, because only the caller knows: a fresh renderer can attach at a non-zero offset, and a renderer can hold an offset after losing its screen. It is required rather than optional so that false and absent are not the same bytes. The best-effort repaint request hangs off this flag, and it is best-effort: SIGWINCH is advisory, an application may repaint partially or not at all, and there is no observable signal saying a complete repaint has occurred.

requestWrite.description: Ask for the session's one write capability. Required rather than optional for the same reason as `fresh`: a reader that did not ask must be distinguishable from one whose request was dropped.
